name: cg_coin_history
description:
A coin's snapshot on one past date from CoinGecko (coins/{id}/history): price, market cap and total volume in many currencies at 00:00 UTC that day.
Returns {id, symbol, name, market_data: {current_price: {currency: value}, market_cap: {...}, total_volume: {...}}, ...}.
Inputs (* required): id* (string, CoinGecko coin id such as bitcoin or ethereum, not the ticker symbol; ids come from cg_search or cg_coin_list), date (string, DD-MM-YYYY; default yesterday, UTC). Without a paid CoinGecko plan only the past 365 days are available.
For a series of days use cg_coin_market_chart or cg_coin_ohlc.
Example: {"id": "bitcoin"}

id.description: CoinGecko coin id (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum), not the ticker symbol

date.description: Date in DD-MM-YYYY format (default yesterday, UTC); keyless and demo keys reach only the past 365 days
